verdict.rationale: Convertio documents its own public API with API keys, a CLI, official wrappers, and OCR available via the API, so core conversion is programmatically accessible. Nothing shows the API matches the full UI feature set, such as video quality, codec, aspect ratio, rotate and flip settings, or all 25,600+ conversions, and no OpenAPI spec was found to confirm parity. Missing for 10: documented parity between API and UI features, API exposure of advanced conversion options, a machine-readable API spec, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
